scope: Five data-structure optimizations; unrelated in-progress workspace changes were preserved.
changes: Retain navigation-only wall-breaching planning views with stable identities and live authoritative inputs.
Share an eight-direction Uint8 terrain edge mask with enclosure flood fills.
Pack structural cell flags and update changed footprints and terrain halos from a bounded, independent-consumer world tile journal.
Retain palace-keyed city economic results across no-op orders; refresh affected cities while preserving faction-wide resident allocation order.
Replicate entity/field deltas and dirty world tiles, preserve client entity indexes, isolate interpolation/fog presentation from authoritative baselines, and bound snapshot/resync queues.

validation.simulationParity: All serialized-state checkpoints through 390 updates match, including fog and RNG state.
validation.replicationParity: Every decoded frame matches the source in real simulation replays and property/entity/field deletion, reordering, and sparse-fog edge cases.

fullSuite.status: Stopped after assertion failures and long-running world-generation timeouts; not a passing full-suite result.
fullSuite.baselineReproductions: Three tundra palette assertions and two multiplayer projectile-reward assertions fail identically before these changes. Offshore assertions pass with 120 seconds, but its major-landform test takes 89.439 seconds on baseline, exceeding the normal 60-second limit.
fullSuite.otherFailures: Additional terrain/world-generation assertions and timeouts were observed; not all were rechecked individually against baseline. A building-activity missing-tile failure is resolved in current source and passes in the focused run.
fullSuite.environment: Another full-suite run was active outside this task. Shared output/ci-tests artifacts are not used as authoritative results for this run.

browser.scope: Local production builds, desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x700; lobby, movement, faction-specific stance, pause controls, reconnect and victory.

websocket.scope: Local server: two players, authoritative movement and commands, rejected cross-faction/invalid orders, terrain replication, disconnect/reconnect, victory and room release.

simulation.method: Simulation-only, navigation WASM enabled, alternating isolated replay order. Wall-clock CPU timings include normal GC, no profiler. Full serialized-state parity includes fog. No rendering/HUD or live FPS measurement.
simulation.environmentNote: Other validation processes were active in the shared workspace. Before/after replay order alternated across four rounds, but wall-clock CPU measurements remain diagnostic; no live FPS claim.

multiplayerReplication.method: Offline replay of real updateGame samples. Alternating full/delta order; encoding includes diff plus JSON stringify, decoding includes JSON parse plus state replacement or actual ClientStateReplica.apply. Setup, simulation, WASM, snapshots, world tile channel, interpolation, renderer/HUD and downstream cache rebuilding are excluded. Not live FPS or network latency.
multiplayerReplication.edgeCoverage: Non-timed property deletion, entity deletion/order, field deletion/order/absence, sparse fog exploration changes.
multiplayerReplication.environmentNote: Other validation processes were active in the shared workspace. Payload byte counts and decoded parity are deterministic; CPU timings remain diagnostic.
multiplayerReplication.tradeoff: The smaller duel sample used about 0.57 ms more server encode time per frame; client decode/apply time and payload size were substantially lower. The large saved settlement also reduced encode time slightly.
multiplayerReplication.snapshotNote: Bandwidth comparisons cover recurring dynamic-state frames. Full join/resync snapshots are retained; the browser scenario had initial world snapshots of 38.9 MB per client. The bounded send queue preserves delta order behind one such snapshot and recovers safely after congestion.

provenance.baseline: Original source captured before implementation, with concurrent unrelated loyalty/diplomacy edits applied equally to the final before/after comparison.
